answers.question: Under Schedule C, what BIS CRS standard covers SKU NM-LFP-1200W, when does CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expire (and what Dec 10 / Dec 15 auto-delist gates apply), and why is NovaMart Air Express banned for UN 3480 LFP dispatches?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Under Schedule C, what BIS CRS standard covers SKU NM-LFP-1200W, when does CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expire (and what Dec 10 / Dec 15 auto-delist gates apply), and why is NovaMart Air Express banned for UN 3480 LFP dispatches?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Schedule C (REG-BIS-EPR-2026) is a standalone regulatory exhibit, untouched by SL-2026-09 (Cl. SL.4(3)) and carved out of the MSA Clause 9.1 cap via Clause 9.2(b)(ii). SKU NM-LFP-1200W is covered by IS 16046 (Part 2):2018 / IEC 62133-2 under BIS CRS Reg. No. R-41209877 (Peenya-Unit-2) (REG-BIS-EPR-2026 Cl. C.1). Air Express is banned for it (Cl. C.3).

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Cl. C.1: NABL lab and BIS surveillance reports must be uploaded 15 days pre-launch and on any cell, electrolyte or BMS MOSFET change; unapproved cell substitution lets NovaMart reject whole lots. Cl. C.2: EPR-KA-2025-08814 expires **December 31, 2026**. answers.question: Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: These four levers sit on separate instruments and do not net against each other. Side Letter #2 (SL-2026-09, Clause SL.4) prevails over MSA-NM-DSA-2026 on exclusivity and the rebate/clawback ceiling; Addendum A (SLA-PEAK-2026, Clause A.1) overrides MSA Clause 4 during Oct 10–Nov 15, 2026; the 1.75% CD is NovaMart's optional treasury election under MSA Clause 3.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: MSA Clause 3: 1.75% flat CD for NEFT/RTGS settlement within T+10 of GRN (base principal otherwise Net T+43). MSA Clause 4: baseline LD of 0.50% per OTIF point below 96.5%, capped at 2.0% monthly. SLA-PEAK-2026 Clause A.4(c): 6.50% cap on Peak PO landed value, plus INR 1,250/pallet-hour dock fees and a 3.50% flash-sale deduction. SL-2026-09 Clause SL.2: exclusivity drops from 24 to 9 months (Dec 31, 2026) unless cumulative POs reach INR 85.00 Cr by Sep 30, 2027, with INR 42.00 Cr by Dec 31, 2026. Clause SL.3: 3.25% ceiling on annual co-op, marketing and rebate clawbacks, expressly excluding A.4 peak LDs and Schedule D escrow/debit adjustments.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Peak cap is 6.50% versus 2.0% baseline, a 4.5-point (3.25x) escalation. Peak LDs and Schedule D adjustments sit outside the 3.25% ceiling, so total deductions can exceed it. CD (1.75%) and clawbacks (3.25%) are not netted by any clause. The rebate ladder is 1.50% / 2.75% / 3.50% at INR 50 / 85 / 120 Cr. Early payment remains inside MSMED Sec 15 and Sec 43B(h) limits.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Before execution, Treasury must confirm the CD election rule, and Category Planning must model the INR 42.00 Cr interim gate. Finance must ring-fence peak LDs outside the 3.25% ceiling. Separately, SBI's NOC under CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129 is required for the KroneVolt waiver (SL.1).

answers.question: What is Deccan's general contractual liability cap under MSA Clause 9.1, and which three statutory schedules are explicitly carved out as UNCAPPED under Clause 9.2 (including exact INR ceilings and required insurance limits)?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

What is Deccan's general contractual liability cap under MSA Clause 9.1, and which three statutory schedules are explicitly carved out as UNCAPPED under Clause 9.2 (including exact INR ceilings and required insurance limits)?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Deccan's Clause 9.1 cap is the GREATER OF INR 4,50,00,000 (INR 4.50 Crore) or 100% of net GMV wholesale payouts invoiced in the trailing twelve months before the first claim event, per twelve-month period. Clause 9.2 overrides both Clause 9.1 and Clause 8 for three uncapped carve-outs: Schedule B (DPDP/CERT-In), Schedule C (BIS/UN 3480/recall) and Schedule D (tax/ITC). Side Letter #2 leaves Schedules B, C and D untouched and fully enforceable alongside Clause 9.2.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Schedule B (DPA-DPDP-2026) Clause B.4: the INR 4.50 Crore cap does NOT apply to Schedule B breaches. Schedule C (REG-BIS-EPR-2026) Clause C.4: Deccan bears uncapped liability for customer refunds, hazardous-disposal fees, FC rack remediation, bodily injury and property fire damage, with a 48-hour recall. Schedule D (TAX-GST-ITC-2026) Clause D.4: the indemnity for ITC disallowances under CGST Section 16(2)(c) or Section 74 proceedings is UNCAPPED and survives expiration for eight (8) years.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Schedule B: DPB penalties carry statutory maximums up to INR 250 Crore for security-safeguard failures and up to INR 200 Crore for failure to notify, with minimum cyber-risk insurance of INR 15.00 Crore. Schedule C: minimum product liability insurance of INR 25,00,00,000 per occurrence; misdeclared air-express shipments trigger INR 5,00,000 per consignment. Schedule D: escrowed 18% GST converts to a debit note, plus 18% p.a. interest under CGST Section 50(3).

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Before execution, verify the INR 15.00 Crore cyber and INR 25 Crore product-liability policies are in force. For the latter, confirm IRDAI-licensed insurer, NovaMart as Additional Insured & Loss Payee, and 30 days non-cancellation. The documents specify no separate insurance limit for Schedule D.

answers.question: During the Oct 10 – Nov 15 Diwali Festive Peak Window, how does Addendum A override baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6 on mandatory OTIF, liquidated damages, penalty cap %, and regional highway transporter strikes lasting under 72 hours?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

During the Oct 10 – Nov 15 Diwali Festive Peak Window, how does Addendum A override baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6 on mandatory OTIF, liquidated damages, penalty cap %, and regional highway transporter strikes lasting under 72 hours?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Addendum A controls. During the Festive Peak Window (Oct 10 – Nov 15, 2026), Clauses A.2–A.5 expressly override and supersede baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6. Side Letter #2 confirms Addendum A strictly prevails over the MSA on peak SLA. Baseline 96.5% terms resume at 00:00 IST on November 16, 2026.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: A.2 raises OTIF from 96.5% to 98.8%, measured weekly (Mon–Sun) instead of monthly, with no carry-over credit. A.4(a) charges INR 1,250 per delayed pallet-hour for misses of the ±30-minute dock window. A.4(b) imposes an instant 3.50% invoice deduction when a Hero Deal slot is delisted. Under A.5, regional strikes, bandhs and similar disruptions lasting under 72 consecutive hours are NOT Force Majeure, versus the 24-hour MSA baseline.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Combined A.4 deductions are capped at 6.50% of total Festive Peak PO landed value, overriding the 2.0% baseline monthly cap, and are settled via automated GST Credit Note adjustment after weekly reconciliation. The baseline LD was 0.50% per percentage-point shortfall. The Side Letter's 3.25% clawback ceiling expressly excludes A.4 liquidated damages. The documents give no INR peak-PO value, so the rupee exposure cannot be calculated.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: By October 5, 2026, Deccan must pre-position ring-fenced buffer stock of 4,500 NM-LFP-1200W and 9,000 NM-AIR-H14 units. NovaMart Category Planning must receive daily ERP feeds confirming no cross-allocation. Any Force Majeure claim beyond 72 hours requires proof that two dedicated fleets were activated within 8 hours and the buffer was exhausted.

answers.question: Does KroneVolt GmbH's proposed 26.0% Series-C equity stake allow NovaMart to terminate under MSA Clause 11.4, what dual Conditions Precedent (including SBI Form CHG-1) bind Side Letter #2 Clause SL.1, and how does Clause SL.2 shorten NovaMart's 24-month LFP exclusivity?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Does KroneVolt GmbH's proposed 26.0% Series-C equity stake allow NovaMart to terminate under MSA Clause 11.4, what dual Conditions Precedent (including SBI Form CHG-1) bind Side Letter #2 Clause SL.1, and how does Clause SL.2 shorten NovaMart's 24-month LFP exclusivity?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Absent a waiver, yes. MSA Clause 11.4 gives NovaMart an immediate termination right for any transfer of 25.0% or more of Deccan's fully diluted voting share capital, and KroneVolt's 26.0% exceeds that. However, Side Letter #2 (SL-2026-09) conditionally waives that right, and Side Letter #2 strictly prevails over the MSA on Change-of-Control consent and exclusivity thresholds.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause 11.4 requires written notice at least 30 days before closing. The waiver under SL.1 is strictly contingent on two Conditions Precedent prior to share allotment: (1) a certified copy of SBI's written NOC satisfying Negative Covenant Clause 14.3 under Form CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129, delivered at least 5 business days before allotment; (2) an absolute telemetry firewall: no API keys, bulk telemetry exports or remote SSH access for KroneVolt, its Munich engineers or its nominee director. Under SL.2, exclusivity automatically expires at nine months (December 31, 2026) unless NovaMart issues binding POs of at least INR 85.00 Crore by September 30, 2027, including INR 42.00 Crore by December 31, 2026. Missing either gate frees Deccan to supply unbranded 1,200 Wh LFP variants to competitors without refunding tooling advances.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: The Series-C raise is INR 65.00 Crore. The waived remedy is a straight-line pro-rata clawback of the unamortized INR 3.80 Cr tooling advance. SBI's covenant prohibits equity allotment exceeding 25.0% dilution or foreign strategic stake entry without prior written SBI NOC. SBI's facility is INR 45.00 Crore, with INR 27.20 Cr drawn as of March 31, 2026.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Do not execute or permit allotment until SBI's NOC is received at least 5 business days prior and the telemetry firewall is verified. Per SL.4, exclusivity expiry never impairs NovaMart's uncapped indemnification, 48-hour recall rights, or 8-year GST audit survival.

Deccan must ingest, store and process 100% of raw IoT telemetry exclusively in AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai), with ap-south-2 (Hyderabad) as DR failover, encrypted with NovaMart Customer-Managed Keys (AWS KMS) and TLS 1.3. answers.question: If a Deccan invoice is missing in NovaMart's GSTR-2B pull, how does Schedule D preserve MSMED Act 45-day & Income Tax Section 43B(h) compliance via split remittance, and what are the exact Rule 37A 180-day cure deadline and permanent 18% p.a. setoff consequences?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

If a Deccan invoice is missing in NovaMart's GSTR-2B pull, how does Schedule D preserve MSMED Act 45-day & Income Tax Section 43B(h) compliance via split remittance, and what are the exact Rule 37A 180-day cure deadline and permanent 18% p.a. setoff consequences?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes. Schedule D (TAX-GST-ITC-2026) uses a bifurcated SAP ERP payment rail whenever a Deccan tax invoice is missing or mismatched in the monthly GSTR-2B pull, so CGST 16(2)(aa) ITC risk is covered without triggering MSMED Sec 15/16 interest or Sec 43B(h) disallowance. Schedule D remains untouched by Side Letter #2 and fully enforceable.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Under D.2(a), NovaMart still releases 100% of the undisputed pre-tax base principal by T+43 days from GRN, inside the 45-day safe harbor. Under D.2(b), only the 18% GST component is withheld (CGST 9% + SGST 9% intra-Karnataka, or IGST 18% inter-state) in a non-interest-bearing Tax Compliance Escrow Holdback Account until the invoice populates cleanly in GSTR-2B. Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Summarize Deccan's FY 2025-26 MCA Form AOC-4 financial health, the CARO 2020 Clause (vii)(b) disputed Maharashtra GST demand & pre-deposit, SBI Form CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129 DSCR covenant, and Note 21 warranty retrofit reserve.
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Deccan is financially sound and covenant-compliant. Auditors issued an UNMODIFIED (clean) opinion on the FY2025-26 AOC-4 (signed Aug 28, 2026). DSCR is 1.62x against the SBI minimum of 1.40x, and TOL/TNW is 1.12x against a 1.75x ceiling. The disputed GST demand is a contingent, non-fraud item under stay.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: CARO 2020 Clause (vii)(b): Maharashtra GST (Mazgaon) Order-in-Original dated Nov 19, 2025, FY2022-23 IGST transition credits, non-fraud after Section 74 allegations were withdrawn. The 10% pre-deposit under Section 107(6) secures an automatic stay pending GSTAT Mumbai. SBI CHG-1 ID 100884129: Negative Covenant Clause 14.3 bars equity dilution above 25.0%, board-control change, or foreign strategic entry without SBI's prior written NOC. Note 21: the retrofit was voluntary, covering 3,100 Gen-1 inverter packs, with zero thermal runaway, BIS notices, or injury/property claims.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Revenue INR 312.40 Cr (+24.80%); EBITDA INR 28.60 Cr (9.15%); PAT INR 14.90 Cr; net worth INR 74.10 Cr, borrowings INR 38.40 Cr, Net Debt/EBITDA 0.89x. GST dispute: INR 6.85 Cr gross (INR 4.60 Cr tax principal); pre-deposit INR 0.685 Cr, leaving INR 6.165 Cr stayed; off-balance-sheet, with Big-4 opinion of ≥75% success. SBI facility: INR 45.00 Cr, no overdue or SMA flags; INR 27.20 Cr drawn. Warranty reserve: INR 2.85 Cr closing (~0.91% of revenue); INR 1.42 Cr utilized.

answers.question: Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Four distinct price levers apply, each under its own instrument. Side Letter #2 prevails over the MSA on exclusivity thresholds and the 3.25% rebate/clawback ceiling; Addendum A prevails on Peak SLA terms. The 3.25% ceiling expressly excludes Peak SLA liquidated damages and Schedule D GST escrow/debit adjustments, so Peak penalties stack outside it.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: MSA Clause 3: NEFT/RTGS settlement within T+10 days of GRN earns a flat 1.75% CD, at NovaMart's sole treasury election. Addendum A Clause A.4(c) caps Peak dock fees and fill-rate deductions at 6.50% of Festive Peak PO landed value, overriding the baseline 2.0% cap. SL.2: LFP exclusivity expires at 9 months (Dec 31, 2026) unless NovaMart issues binding POs of at least INR 85.00 Cr by Sept 30, 2027, including INR 42.00 Cr by Dec 31, 2026. SL.3 caps annual co-op, banner, marketing and rebate clawbacks at 3.25% of Deccan's net wholesale purchases.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Cap gap: 6.50% vs 2.0% is +4.50 points. Peak levers are INR 1,250 per pallet-hour and a 3.50% flash-sale deduction. Missing either exclusivity gate frees Deccan to supply competitors without refunding unamortized tooling. That tooling advance is INR 3.80 Cr. The CD must not push settlement past the MSMED Section 15 45-day ceiling or endanger the Section 43B(h) deduction.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Treasury must confirm T+10 CD elections in SAP against the 43B(h) safe harbor. Category Planning must certify the INR 42.00 Cr interim PO gate before Dec 31, 2026. Finance must reconcile Peak penalties and the 3.25% clawback separately, since the 3.25% ceiling excludes Peak SLA damages.

answers.question: What is Deccan's general contractual liability cap under MSA Clause 9.1, and which three statutory schedules are explicitly carved out as UNCAPPED under Clause 9.2 (including exact INR ceilings and required insurance limits)?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

What is Deccan's general contractual liability cap under MSA Clause 9.1, and which three statutory schedules are explicitly carved out as UNCAPPED under Clause 9.2 (including exact INR ceilings and required insurance limits)?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: The Clause 9.1 general cap is the GREATER OF INR 4,50,00,000 (INR 4.50 Cr) or 100% of net GMV wholesale payouts invoiced by NovaMart to Deccan in the trailing 12 months, and it is subject strictly to Clause 9.2. Clause 9.2 overrides Clauses 9.1 and 8 and leaves three areas uncapped: Schedule B (DPDP/CERT-In), Schedule C (BIS/UN 3480/recall) and Schedule D (GST/ITC).

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause B.4 states that the INR 4.50 Cr cap does NOT apply to Schedule B breaches. Clause C.4 requires a pre-funded recall within 48 hours and carves out refunds, hazardous disposal, bodily injury and fire damage. Clause D.4 makes the GST indemnity (CGST Sec 16(2)(c)/Sec 74) uncapped and survives expiry for eight years.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: DPB penalties carry statutory maximums up to INR 250 Cr for security-safeguard failures and up to INR 200 Cr for failure to notify. Cyber-risk insurance must be at least INR 15.00 Cr. Product liability cover must be at least INR 25,00,00,000 per occurrence. The Schedule D excerpt states no INR ceiling or insurance requirement, so that exposure is open-ended. The INR 15 Cr cyber cover is far below the INR 250 Cr penalty maximum.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Before execution, verify the cyber policy (INR 15 Cr) and the CGL/recall policy (INR 25 Cr). The CGL policy must come from an IRDAI-licensed insurer, name NovaMart Commerce India Pvt. Ltd. as Additional Insured & Loss Payee, and carry a 30-day non-cancellation undertaking. Also confirm the quarterly independent GST tax sign-off on HSN classification.

answers.question: During the Oct 10 – Nov 15 Diwali Festive Peak Window, how does Addendum A override baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6 on mandatory OTIF, liquidated damages, penalty cap %, and regional highway transporter strikes lasting under 72 hours?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

During the Oct 10 – Nov 15 Diwali Festive Peak Window, how does Addendum A override baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6 on mandatory OTIF, liquidated damages, penalty cap %, and regional highway transporter strikes lasting under 72 hours?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes, Addendum A controls. During the Festive Peak Window (October 10 – November 15, 2026), Clauses A.2–A.5 expressly override and supersede baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6. It applies automatically, with no annual re-execution. Baseline 96.5% terms resume at 00:00 IST on November 16, 2026.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: **A.2:** OTIF rises from 96.5% to 98.8%, measured weekly rather than monthly, with zero carry-over credit. Trucks must check in within ±30 minutes of the WMS dock slot. **A.4:** replaces baseline Clause 4.2 with tiered remedies. answers.question: Does KroneVolt GmbH's proposed 26.0% Series-C equity stake allow NovaMart to terminate under MSA Clause 11.4, what dual Conditions Precedent (including SBI Form CHG-1) bind Side Letter #2 Clause SL.1, and how does Clause SL.2 shorten NovaMart's 24-month LFP exclusivity?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Does KroneVolt GmbH's proposed 26.0% Series-C equity stake allow NovaMart to terminate under MSA Clause 11.4, what dual Conditions Precedent (including SBI Form CHG-1) bind Side Letter #2 Clause SL.1, and how does Clause SL.2 shorten NovaMart's 24-month LFP exclusivity?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes, absent a waiver. The 26.0% stake exceeds the 25.0% trigger in MSA Clause 11.4, which entitles NovaMart to terminate immediately and claw back unamortized tooling advances if no written waiver exists before closing. However, Side Letter #2 (SL-2026-09) strictly prevails over the MSA on KroneVolt Change-of-Control consent and the LFP 9-month/24-month exclusivity thresholds. NovaMart has conditionally waived termination and clawback, so termination is available only if the conditions fail.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: SL.1 imposes two Conditions Precedent before share allotment: (1) a certified SBI No-Objection Certificate satisfying Negative Covenant Clause 14.3 under MCA Form CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129, delivered at least 5 business days before allotment; and (2) an absolute telemetry firewall barring KroneVolt, its Munich engineers, and its nominee director from API keys, bulk telemetry exports, or remote SSH access to Indian IoT data or AWS ap-south-1/ap-south-2 KMS realms (Schedule B, Clause B.2). MSA Clause 5.4 grants 24 months of exclusivity from April 1, 2026. SL.2 makes exclusivity for NM-LFP-1200W expire automatically at 9 months (December 31, 2026) unless NovaMart issues binding, non-cancellable POs of at least INR 85.00 Crore, with INR 42.00 Crore ordered by December 31, 2026, before 23:59 IST on September 30, 2027.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: The Series-C round is INR 65.00 Crore, with KroneVolt taking 26.0% post-money. The waived tooling clawback is INR 3.80 Cr. If either the INR 42.00 Cr or INR 85.00 Cr gate is missed, Deccan may supply unbranded 1,200 Wh LFP OEM variants to competing marketplaces without refunding unamortized tooling advances. NovaMart's uncapped indemnification, 48-hour recall rights, and 8-year GST audit survival remain unimpaired.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Before allotment, verify the certified SBI NOC (Clause 14.3, CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129) at least 5 business days ahead, and confirm the telemetry firewall. The documents do not specify any other escrow or delisting gate.

answers.question: Under Schedule B (DPDP Act 2023), where must Indian smart-appliance IoT telemetry and KMS keys reside, and what are Deccan's exact 4-hour CERT-In feeder, 24-hour key rotation, and 72-hour DPB breach timelines?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Under Schedule B (DPDP Act 2023), where must Indian smart-appliance IoT telemetry and KMS keys reside, and what are Deccan's exact 4-hour CERT-In feeder, 24-hour key rotation, and 72-hour DPB breach timelines?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Telemetry must stay in India. Deccan must ingest, store and process 100% of raw IoT telemetry exclusively in AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai), with ap-south-2 (Hyderabad) as DR failover, encrypted with NovaMart-controlled CMKs via AWS KMS. Offshore replication or access (including by foreign shareholders) is barred without NovaMart's prior written CISO & DPO authorization. Side Letter #2 reinforces this through a telemetry firewall against KroneVolt GmbH.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause B.2(a) requires 90-day automatic CMK rotation, TLS 1.3 in transit, and AWS SCP guardrails blocking cross-region S3 replication and EBS snapshot sharing. Clause B.3 timelines: a preliminary machine-readable incident packet to NovaMart SOC within 4 consecutive hours of detection; within 24 hours, revoke all compromised X.509 MQTT certificates, broker credentials and signing keys; within 72 hours, a forensic root-cause dossier so NovaMart can file DPB and Data Principal notifications.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: CERT-In's statutory window is 6 hours, so the 4-hour feeder leaves a 2-hour buffer. Deccan's INR 4.50 Crore liability cap does not apply to Schedule B breaches. DPB penalties reach up to INR 250 Crore for security-safeguard failures and up to INR 200 Crore for failure to notify, and Deccan indemnifies 100% of them. Minimum cyber insurance is INR 15.00 Crore.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Deccan must deliver CERT-In empanelled VAPT clearance certificates every 180 days. Before any KroneVolt share allotment, SBI's written NOC under Clause 14.3 (CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129) is required at least 5 business days prior, together with confirmation of the telemetry firewall.

answers.question: If a Deccan invoice is missing in NovaMart's GSTR-2B pull, how does Schedule D preserve MSMED Act 45-day & Income Tax Section 43B(h) compliance via split remittance, and what are the exact Rule 37A 180-day cure deadline and permanent 18% p.a. setoff consequences?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

If a Deccan invoice is missing in NovaMart's GSTR-2B pull, how does Schedule D preserve MSMED Act 45-day & Income Tax Section 43B(h) compliance via split remittance, and what are the exact Rule 37A 180-day cure deadline and permanent 18% p.a. setoff consequences?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes. Clause D.2's bifurcated SAP ERP payment rail applies whenever a Deccan tax invoice is missing or mismatched in the monthly GSTR-2B pull, so NovaMart protects its ITC position without triggering MSMED interest or a 43B(h) disallowance.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Under D.2(a), NovaMart still releases 100% of the undisputed pre-tax base principal by T+43 days from GRN. This sits inside the 45-day safe harbor (a 2-day buffer under MSMED Section 15). Under D.2(b), only the 18% GST component is withheld in a non-interest-bearing escrow until the invoice populates cleanly in GSTR-2B. Under D.3, cure runs to the EARLIER of 180 calendar days from the invoice date or September 30 following the relevant Financial Year close (aligned to CGST Rule 37A). If cured, release is automatic on the following Friday AP run with zero deduction.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: On failure to cure, the escrowed 18% GST converts permanently into a non-refundable commercial debit note against Deccan's vendor ledger, plus interest recovery at 18% p.a. under CGST Section 50(3) and any Section 73/74 penalty assessed against NovaMart. Undisputed delay past Day 45 would otherwise accrue compound interest at three times the RBI Bank Rate (MSMED Section 16). Deccan's indemnity for 16(2)(c)/Section 74 exposure is UNCAPPED and survives eight years. The deal-room text gives no INR/Crore figures.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Before execution, confirm that Deccan's GSTR-1 is filed by the 11th and GSTR-3B by the 20th, and that SAP is configured for the split rail. The text specifies no banking NOC or escrow-bank requirement beyond the Tax Compliance Escrow Holdback Account.

answers.answer_markdown:

answers.question: Under Schedule C, what BIS CRS standard covers SKU NM-LFP-1200W, when does CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expire (and what Dec 10 / Dec 15 auto-delist gates apply), and why is NovaMart Air Express banned for UN 3480 LFP dispatches?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Under Schedule C, what BIS CRS standard covers SKU NM-LFP-1200W, when does CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expire (and what Dec 10 / Dec 15 auto-delist gates apply), and why is NovaMart Air Express banned for UN 3480 LFP dispatches?

segments.text: - **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: SKU NM-LFP-1200W is covered by
IS 16046 (Part 2): 2018 / IEC 62133-2 under BIS CRS Registration No. R-41209877, factory code Peenya-Unit-2
. CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814
expires on December 31, 2026
. Air Express is banned because the
1,200 Wh pack exceeds the 100 Wh IATA PI 965 exception threshold by 12x, making it UN 3480 Class 9

.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause C.2 requires
renewal confirmation and quarterly Form-3 recycling credit certificates by December 10, 2026
. If not verified
by 18:00 IST on December 10, NovaMart may auto-delist, suppress Buy-Box and inventory-freeze all Deccan battery and appliance ASINs effective December 15, 2026, without penalty or notice
. Clause C.3(a)
prohibits tendering or cross-docking the SKU on any Air Express or belly-cargo manifest

.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Misdeclaration triggers
INR 5,00,000 per-consignment liquidated indemnity plus DGCA reporting
. Recall liability is
uncapped, carved out from the MSA Clause 9.1 cap
, backed by
INR 25,00,00,000 per-occurrence insurance

.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Before execution, require:
  -
NABL and BIS surveillance reports uploaded at least 15 days before SKU launch
PRO recycler tie-ups covering 100% of FY27 collection targets
surface-only dispatch at SoC ≤30% with a UN 38.3 summary attached to the e-Way Bill
insurance naming NovaMart as Additional Insured and Loss Payee, with 30 days' non-cancellation

.

The deal-room text contains no banking NOC or escrow requirement.

answers.question: Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: These are four separate price levers, not one stacked ceiling. During the Festive Peak Window (Oct 10 to Nov 15, 2026), Addendum A Clauses A.2 through A.5 expressly override and supersede baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6. The SL.3 3.25% ceiling expressly excludes Peak SLA liquidated damages under Clause A.4, so peak penalties sit outside it.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause 3's 1.75% CD applies only at NovaMart's sole treasury election, for NEFT/RTGS settlement within T+10 days of GRN. Otherwise settlement is Net T+43 from GRN. A.4 imposes INR 1,250 per delayed pallet-hour and an instant 3.50% deduction on the unfulfilled PO tranche. SL.2 is a volume gate, not a price lever: exclusivity expires at nine months (Dec 31, 2026) unless binding POs reach INR 85.00 Crore by Sept 30, 2027.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: A.4 combined deductions are capped at 6.50% of Festive Peak PO landed value, versus the 2.0% baseline monthly cap, a 4.5-point uplift. SL.3 rebates run 1.50% at INR 50 Cr, 2.75% at INR 85 Cr and 3.50% at INR 120 Cr. Clawbacks are capped at 3.25% of annual net wholesale purchases. Undisputed delays beyond Day 45 accrue interest at three times the RBI Bank Rate. A miss on the INR 42.00 Cr interim gate or the INR 85 Cr hurdle frees Deccan to supply unbranded LFP variants to competitors, with no refund of unamortized tooling advances.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: The documents specify no banking NOC or escrow gate. My recommendation is that Treasury sign off on the CD election only if payment stays inside Day 45 (Section 43B(h)), and that Finance confirm the INR 42 Cr and INR 85 Cr PO plan before execution.

- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Deccan's general cap under Clause 9.1 is the GREATER OF INR 4,50,00,000 (INR 4.50 Cr) or 100% of net GMV wholesale payouts invoiced in the trailing twelve months before the first claim event, applied per twelve-month period. This cap is "subject strictly to Clause 9.2." The three schedules sit outside it, and Schedules B, C and D remain completely untouched and fully enforceable alongside Clause 9.2 uncapped carve-outs under Side Letter SL.4. (Kaveri's DOC-08 terms are excluded.)

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause 9.2 says nothing in Clause 9.1 or Clause 8 limits Deccan's liability for (i) Schedule B (DPA-DPDP-2026) data/telemetry/CERT-In matters; (ii) Schedule C (REG-BIS-EPR-2026) BIS CRS, UN 3480, injury, fire and the mandatory 48-hour nationwide recall; and (iii) Schedule D (TAX-GST-ITC-2026) fraudulent invoicing, blocked ITC under CGST Section 16(2)(c)/Section 74, and tax assessments. Clause B.4 confirms the INR 4.50 Cr cap does NOT apply to Schedule B breaches. Clause C.4 carves Schedule C out of the Clause 9.1 cap.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: DPDP penalties carry statutory maximums up to INR 250 Crore for failure to maintain reasonable security safeguards, and up to INR 200 Crore for failure to notify the DPB/Data Principals. Required insurance: cyber-risk cover of at least INR 15.00 Crore for IoT telemetry incidents, and CGL/Product Liability (with Recall Expense Extension) of at least INR 25,00,00,000 per occurrence with an IRDAI-licensed insurer. The documents give no INR ceiling for Schedule D.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Before execution, obtain evidence of the INR 15 Cr cyber policy and the INR 25 Cr CGL policy. The latter must name NovaMart Commerce India Pvt. Ltd. as Additional Insured & Loss Payee, with a 30-day non-cancellation undertaking. Recall pre-funding must be operational for the 48-hour trigger.

answers.question: During the Oct 10 – Nov 15 Diwali Festive Peak Window, how does Addendum A override baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6 on mandatory OTIF, liquidated damages, penalty cap %, and regional highway transporter strikes lasting under 72 hours?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

During the Oct 10 – Nov 15 Diwali Festive Peak Window, how does Addendum A override baseline MSA Clauses 4 and 6 on mandatory OTIF, liquidated damages, penalty cap %, and regional highway transporter strikes lasting under 72 hours?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes. Addendum A (SLA-PEAK-2026) is an integral binding schedule to MSA-NM-DSA-2026 and applies automatically, with no annual re-execution. From Oct 10 to Nov 15, 2026, Clauses A.2–A.5 expressly override and supersede MSA Clauses 4 and 6. Baseline terms resume at 00:00 IST on Nov 16, 2026. I excluded DOC-16, which has different dates and belongs to a different MSA.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Under **A.2**, mandatory OTIF rises from 96.5% to 98.8%, measured weekly (Monday to Sunday) with zero carry-over credit. Trucks must check in within ±30 minutes of the WMS dock slot. **A.4** replaces baseline Clause 4.2. Under **A.5**, transporter strikes and highway bandhs lasting under 72 hours do NOT qualify as Force Majeure. Even beyond 72 hours, Deccan must have activated two dedicated third-party fleets within 8 hours and exhausted the buffer units.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Dock detention is INR 1,250 per delayed pallet-hour. A delisted Hero Deal triggers an instant 3.50% invoice deduction. The combined cap is 6.50% of Festive Peak PO landed value, overriding the baseline 2.0% cap, and is settled via GST Credit Note after weekly reconciliation. The provided text cites no DPDP, CERT-In, MSMED, CGST, BIS or MCA sections for this issue.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: By Oct 5, 2026, Deccan must pre-position ring-fenced buffer stock of 4,500 units of NM-LFP-1200W and 9,000 units of NM-AIR-H14, split 55%/45% between Peenya and Bhiwandi. NovaMart must also receive daily ERP inventory snapshots confirming zero cross-allocation. The excerpts specify no banking NOC or escrow gate.

answers.question: Does KroneVolt GmbH's proposed 26.0% Series-C equity stake allow NovaMart to terminate under MSA Clause 11.4, what dual Conditions Precedent (including SBI Form CHG-1) bind Side Letter #2 Clause SL.1, and how does Clause SL.2 shorten NovaMart's 24-month LFP exclusivity?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Does KroneVolt GmbH's proposed 26.0% Series-C equity stake allow NovaMart to terminate under MSA Clause 11.4, what dual Conditions Precedent (including SBI Form CHG-1) bind Side Letter #2 Clause SL.1, and how does Clause SL.2 shorten NovaMart's 24-month LFP exclusivity?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: NovaMart holds immediate termination and INR 3.80 Cr tooling-clawback rights under MSA Clause 11.4 arising from the 26.0% KroneVolt transaction, but it conditionally waives them. On KroneVolt Change-of-Control consent and the 9-month/24-month exclusivity thresholds, Side Letter #2 (SL-2026-09) strictly prevails over MSA-NM-DSA-2026.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: The SL.1 waiver is strictly contingent on two Conditions Precedent before share allotment: (1) a certified SBI No-Objection Certificate satisfying Negative Covenant Clause 14.3 under MCA Form CHG-1 Charge ID 100884129, delivered at least 5 business days before allotment; and (2) a telemetry firewall barring KroneVolt, its Munich engineers and its nominee director from API keys, bulk exports or SSH access to Indian customer IoT data and AWS ap-south-1/ap-south-2 KMS realms (Schedule B, Clause B.2). Clause SL.2 overrides the 24-month exclusivity in MSA Clause 5.4. Exclusivity on SKU NM-LFP-1200W automatically expires at 9 months (effective December 31, 2026) unless NovaMart issues binding POs of at least INR 85.00 Cr by 23:59 IST on September 30, 2027, including INR 42.00 Cr by December 31, 2026.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: The Series-C round is INR 65.00 Cr. The SBI facilities total INR 45.00 Cr (INR 35.00 Cr fund-based and INR 10.00 Cr non-fund-based). Clause 14.3 prohibits equity allotment above 25.0% dilution or foreign strategic stake entry without SBI's prior written NOC, so the 26.0% stake needs it. If either the INR 42.00 Cr or INR 85.00 Cr gate is missed, Deccan may supply unbranded 1,200 Wh OEM variants to competing marketplaces without refunding unamortized tooling advances. Uncapped indemnification, 48-hour recall rights and 8-year GST audit survival remain unimpaired.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Do not permit share allotment until the certified SBI NOC is on file at least 5 business days earlier, so the working capital lines stay uninterrupted. NovaMart should also confirm that the Schedule B, Clause B.2 telemetry firewall is in force.

answers.question: Under Schedule B (DPDP Act 2023), where must Indian smart-appliance IoT telemetry and KMS keys reside, and what are Deccan's exact 4-hour CERT-In feeder, 24-hour key rotation, and 72-hour DPB breach timelines?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Under Schedule B (DPDP Act 2023), where must Indian smart-appliance IoT telemetry and KMS keys reside, and what are Deccan's exact 4-hour CERT-In feeder, 24-hour key rotation, and 72-hour DPB breach timelines?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes. Deccan must ingest, store and process 100% of raw IoT telemetry exclusively in AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai), with ap-south-2 (Hyderabad) as DR failover, encrypted with NovaMart Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) via AWS KMS. The clause does not separately state a KMS key region. Only Deccan's Schedule B terms apply; the 5-hour and 96-hour terms in DOC-17 belong to Narmada and are excluded.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause B.2(a) sets 90-day automatic key rotation, TLS 1.3 in transit, and AWS SCP guardrails blocking cross-region S3 replication or EBS snapshot sharing. Clause B.3 sets the timelines: a preliminary incident packet to the NovaMart SOC within 4 consecutive hours of detection, revocation of compromised X.509 certificates, broker credentials and signing keys within 24 hours, and a forensic root-cause dossier within 72 hours for DPB and Data Principal notifications.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Deccan's INR 4.50 Crore liability cap does NOT apply to Schedule B breaches. Deccan indemnifies 100% of DPB penalties, up to INR 250 Crore for security-safeguard failures and up to INR 200 Crore for failure to notify. Cyber-risk insurance of at least INR 15.00 Crore is required. The 4-hour feeder sits inside the CERT-In 6-hour reporting rule.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Offshore parent, investor or foreign shareholder access requires NovaMart's prior written CISO & DPO authorization and Section 16 DPDP safeguards. Before execution, also confirm CERT-In empanelled VAPT clearance certificates every 180 days and the INR 15.00 Crore insurance evidence.

answers.question: If a Deccan invoice is missing in NovaMart's GSTR-2B pull, how does Schedule D preserve MSMED Act 45-day & Income Tax Section 43B(h) compliance via split remittance, and what are the exact Rule 37A 180-day cure deadline and permanent 18% p.a. setoff consequences?
answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

If a Deccan invoice is missing in NovaMart's GSTR-2B pull, how does Schedule D preserve MSMED Act 45-day & Income Tax Section 43B(h) compliance via split remittance, and what are the exact Rule 37A 180-day cure deadline and permanent 18% p.a. setoff consequences?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes. NovaMart still releases 100% of the undisputed pre-tax base principal by T+43 days from GRN, inside the 45-day MSMED/43B(h) safe harbor. Only the GST component is held back. Only Deccan's contracts were used; the Kaveri document (DOC-12) was excluded.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Under Clause D.2(b), only the 18% GST component is withheld, in a non-interest-bearing Tax Compliance Escrow Holdback Account, until the invoice populates cleanly in GSTR-2B without Section 16(2)(c) supplier-default flags. Under Clause D.3, a timely GSTR-1 IFF/amendment or Form DRC-03 deposit releases the escrow on the following Friday AP run with zero administrative deduction. The cure window ends on the EARLIER of 180 calendar days from the original tax invoice date or September 30 following the close of the relevant Financial Year.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: On failure to cure, the escrowed 18% GST converts permanently into a non-refundable debit note against Deccan's vendor ledger, plus interest recovery at 18% p.a. under CGST Section 50(3) and any Section 73/74 penalty assessed against NovaMart. If principal slips past Day 45, compound interest accrues at three times the RBI Bank Rate under MSMED Section 16. The text gives no INR/Crore figures.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Deccan must file GSTR-1 by the 11th and GSTR-3B by the 20th of the month after dispatch. The invoice must then show cleanly in GSTR-2B before the Rule 37A deadline. The excerpts specify no banking NOC or delisting gate.

answers.question_as_asked:
Deal room under audit: DR-NM-DECCAN-2026-Q4 (supplier: Deccan Smart Appliances & Energy Pvt. Ltd.). Answer for this supplier's contracts only.

Under Schedule C, what BIS CRS standard covers SKU NM-LFP-1200W, when does CPCB certificate EPR-KA-2025-08814 expire (and what Dec 10 / Dec 15 auto-delist gates apply), and why is NovaMart Air Express banned for UN 3480 LFP dispatches?
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: Yes, Schedule C governs. SKU NM-LFP-1200W is governed under IS 16046 (Part 2): 2018 / IEC 62133-2, under BIS CRS Registration No. R-41209877, factory code Peenya-Unit-2. Air Express is banned because the 1,200 Wh pack exceeds the 100 Wh IATA PI 965 threshold by 12x, making it UN 3480 Class 9 Dangerous Goods.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: C.1 requires NABL and BIS surveillance reports in the Compliance Vault at least 15 days before SKU launch and on any cell, electrolyte or BMS MOSFET change notice. Unapproved substitutions let NovaMart reject whole container lots. C.2: EPR-KA-2025-08814 expires December 31, 2026. If renewal is not verified by 18:00 IST on December 10, 2026, NovaMart may delist, suppress Buy-Box and freeze inventory effective December 15, 2026, without penalty or notice. C.3(b) permits only DG-certified surface linehaul at SoC ≤30%, with UN 4G cartons and a UN 38.3 summary on the e-Way Bill.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Air misdeclaration triggers INR 5,00,000 per-consignment liquidated indemnity plus DGCA reporting. The December 10 deadline is 21 days before expiry and requires PRO tie-ups for 100% of FY27 collection targets plus quarterly Form-3 certificates. The delist carries no breach liability for NovaMart. The provided Schedule C text states no other statutory figures.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Before execution, confirm that valid NABL and BIS reports are in the Compliance Vault. Confirm that CPCB renewal and Form-3 evidence is on the portal by December 10, 2026, 18:00 IST. Confirm that all NM-LFP-1200W lanes are surface-only. No banking NOC or escrow gate appears in the provided text.

answers.question: Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.question_as_asked:

Contrast all commercial price adjustments across the deal room: T+10 Early-Settlement Cash Discount (Clause 3), Addendum A Peak SLA penalty cap vs MSA baseline cap, Side Letter #2 INR 85 Cr exclusivity hurdle, and the Clause SL.3 3.25% annual rebate clawback ceiling.
answers.answer_markdown:
- **Verdict / Controlling Rule**: There is no single price stack. Side Letter #2 (SL-2026-09) prevails over the MSA on the 24-month/9-month exclusivity thresholds and the 3.25% rebate/clawback ceiling, and Addendum A prevails on the Festive Peak SLA. The MSA Clause 3 cash discount stands on its own terms.

- **Key Clauses & Override Mechanics**: Clause 3's 1.75% CD applies only to invoices paid by NEFT/RTGS within T+10 days of GRN, at NovaMart's sole treasury election. Addendum A carries a 98.8% OTIF target, an INR 1,250/pallet-hr fee and a 6.5% cap. The MSA baseline cap is not in the provided text, so it cannot be contrasted. SL.2 expires exclusivity at 9 months unless INR 85.00 Cr of POs are issued by 30 Sep 2027, with INR 42.00 Cr by 31 Dec 2026. SL.3 caps promotional and clawback claims at 3.25%, excluding Addendum A Clause A.4 LDs and Schedule D adjustments.

- **Quantified Financial / Statutory Exposure**: Missing either gate frees Deccan to supply competing marketplaces without refunding unamortized tooling advances. Payment is Net T+43; delays beyond Day 45 accrue compound interest at three times the RBI Bank Rate (MSMED Sec 15/16), and Sec 43B(h) deduction is at risk. The rebate ladder tops out at 3.50% above INR 120.00 Cr, which sits above the 3.25% ceiling. Counsel should confirm how the two interact.

- **Required Sign-Off Gate**: Obtain the MSA baseline cap text, confirm the ladder/ceiling interaction, and have treasury confirm the T+10 versus T+43 election. Uncapped indemnification, 48

[DOC-07#c02 · Clause SL.2 (Exclusivity Cut from 24 Mo to 9 Mo Below INR 85 Cr POs)]
CLAUSE SL.2 (AMENDMENT OF MSA CLAUSE 5.4 — CONDITIONAL REDUCTION OF LFP EXCLUSIVITY): Expressly overriding the unconditional 24-month Exclusivity Period set forth in MSA Clause 5.4, the parties agree that NovaMart's private-label exclusivity for SKU NM-LFP-1200W (1,200 Wh LFP Portable Power Station) SHALL AUTOMATICALLY EXPIRE AT NINE (9) MONTHS (effective December 31, 2026) UNLESS NovaMart issues cumulative binding, non-cancellable Purchase Orders aggregating at least INR 85.00 Crore (Rupees Eighty-Five Crore landed value, net of GST) across Deccan SKUs prior to 23:59 IST on September 30, 2027 (with at least INR 42.00 Crore ordered in the initial 9-month milestone ending December 31, 2026).

citations.document_title: DOC-07#c03 :: SL-2026-09 · Clause SL.3 (Volume Rebate Tiers & 3.25% Promotional Clawback Cap)
citations.clause_ref: Clause SL.3 (Volume Rebate Tiers & 3.25% Promotional Clawback Cap)
citations.cited_text: Provided further that aggregate annual promotional co-op fees, catalog banner charges, marketing deductions, and volume rebate clawbacks claimed by NovaMart against Deccan (EXPRESSLY EXCLUDING punitive Peak SLA liquidated damages assessed under Addendum A Clause A.4 and GST escrow/debit adjustments under Schedule D) shall NEVER exceed a hard contractual ceiling of 3.25% of Deccan's realized annual net wholesale purchases.

citations.document_title: DOC-07#c02 :: SL-2026-09 · Clause SL.2 (Exclusivity Cut from 24 Mo to 9 Mo Below INR 85 Cr POs)
citations.clause_ref: Clause SL.2 (Exclusivity Cut from 24 Mo to 9 Mo Below INR 85 Cr POs)
citations.cited_text: If NovaMart fails to meet either the INR 42.00 Cr interim gate or INR 85.00 Crore cumulative hurdle, Deccan becomes free to supply unbranded 1,200 Wh LFP OEM variants to competing horizontal/quick-commerce marketplaces without refunding unamortized tooling advances, while keeping SKU NM-AIR-H14 firmware proprietary.

citations.document_title: DOC-01#c01 :: MSA-NM-DSA-2026 · Clauses 1–3 (Scope, MSMED 45-Day Settlement & Early-Pay CD)
citations.clause_ref: Clauses 1–3 (Scope, MSMED 45-Day Settlement & Early-Pay CD)
citations.cited_text: Accordingly, NovaMart shall settle 100% of undisputed Base Invoice Principal (pre-GST taxable value) on Net T+43 calendar days measured strictly from the physical Goods Receipt Note ('GRN') timestamp at the destination NovaMart FC, maintaining a 2-day buffer inside the mandatory 45-day ceiling under Section 15 of the MSMED Act, 2006 and preserving NovaMart's corporate tax deduction under Section 43B(h) of the Income Tax Act, 1961. Undisputed delays beyond Day 45 accrue compound statutory interest at three times the RBI Bank Rate notified under Section 16 of the MSMED Act.

citations.cited_text:
[DOC-07#c03 · Clause SL.3 (Volume Rebate Tiers & 3.25% Promotional Clawback Cap)]
CLAUSE SL.3 (BACK-END VOLUME REBATES & 3.25% CLAWBACK CEILING): In connection with KroneVolt's incoming institutional board governance and working-capital debt-coverage covenants, annual back-end volume growth rebates payable by Deccan to NovaMart apply on a strictly progressive annual net-purchase ladder reconciled within 30 days after March 31 fiscal close: 1.50% upon crossing INR 50.00 Crore, 2.75% upon crossing INR 85.00 Crore, and 3.50% upon crossing INR 120.00 Crore in cumulative annual net invoiced PO value (settled via CGST Section 34 commercial/tax credit notes).

citations.document_title: DOC-07#c04 :: SL-2026-09 · Clause SL.4 (Precedence Hierarchy Over MSA vs. Intact Schedules)
citations.clause_ref: Clause SL.4 (Precedence Hierarchy Over MSA vs. Intact Schedules)
citations.cited_text: Expiry or non-fulfillment of the INR 85.00 Cr exclusivity hurdle under Clause SL.2 shall never impair NovaMart's uncapped indemnification, 48-hour recall rights, or 8-year GST audit survival.
